prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return strict TypeScript module solution.ts.
Required API: export function quotaLedger(input: string): string | null
Behavior: Parse limit;account:delta records. Limit is a canonical unsigned decimal in 0..10000000; accounts use ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*; deltas are canonical signed decimals in -10000000..10000000. Apply in order from zero and reject any balance below zero or above limit. Return all touched account balances sorted by account.
Visible example: 10;a:4,b:3,a:-1 returns a=3,b=3.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code:
const f:(s:string)=>string|null=(s:string)=>{const p=s.split(';'),u=/^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/,i=/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/,k=/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/;if(p.length!==2||!u.test(p[0])||Number(p[0])>10000000||!p[1])return null;const limit=Number(p[0]),d=new Map;for(const r of p[1].split(',')){const q=r.split(':');if(q.length!==2||!k.test(q[0])||!i.test(q[1])||Math.abs(Number(q[1]))>10000000)return null;const v=(d.get(q[0])||0)+Number(q[1]);if(v<0||v>limit)return null;d.set(q[0],v)}return[...d].sort().map(x=>x[0]+'='+x[1]).join(',')};
export function quotaLedger(input:string):string|null{return f(input)}
